drag.cancel: Escape/lost capture/window deactivation restore initial ratio and release capture
drag.clamp_rule: apply content minima first; if infeasible collapse into switchable panels; never produce minRatio > maxRatio

ime.escape_during_composition: IME handles first; do not dismiss ancestor dialog
ime.send_ack_rule: persist immutable draft/outbox entry before submission; clear the matching draft only after durable acceptance; idempotency key required for retry

scroll.repin: explicit jump-to-latest or user intentionally returns to bottom; never by timer alone
scroll.stream_reveal: append without blur or glyph motion
scroll.unpin: any user upward intent immediately enters reading-history, even within tolerance

text_surface.acceptance: public state/transactions, real Gallery and independent consumer, GPU comparison, and physical/native experience are separate evidence
text_surface.host: pass the current pointer position to TextSurface.pointer_state; None means no hover. Host owns focus/cursor routing. Before disabling, blur, deactivation or unmount call existing cancel_interaction; disabled projection always suppresses hover/pressed immediately.

hover.hit_region: visible frame including padding, intersected with ancestor clip

text_surface.ime: hover leaves marked text and selection unchanged; accepted pointer_down retains existing unmark transaction; cancellation releases capture without rolling back the visible selection or draft

presentation.motion: none; no Button wash, tint, border substitution, scaling or press animation

pressed.activation: no Button-style release activation; caret/selection/scroll feedback only
pressed.begin: accepted primary pointer_down for caret placement, text selection or scrollbar drag
pressed.outside_capture: pressed remains true while captured even outside hover region

text_surface.state_source: derive ControlState from current visible hit geometry, TextInput.disabled, and the existing pointer capture; no retained hover state or second press state machine
